body.purpose: Table rows, card titles, meta: Inter 15px / 500, -0.03em.

prose.purpose: Intro paragraphs in graphite, line-height 1.625, max 512px.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Every surface. Depth is tone plus a 1px hairline.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Every transition (0.2s) and the dock entrance (0.5s fade + 20px rise). CSS var --settle; Framer [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].

motion.name: screenshot-zoom
motion.purpose: Carousel screenshot on card hover/focus, clipped inside its well; the card never moves.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Kills transitions, animations and smooth scrolling for reduced-motion users.

components.name: Info Row
components.description: Label | text | aside grid used by Work, Recognition, Research, Contact and the footer.
components.html:
Independent
Freelance websites, apps and ESP32 builds
2024 - now
components.css: .ds-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; max-width: 576px; font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 128px 1fr auto; column-gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; margin: 0; } .ds-label, .ds-aside { color: #6e6e6e; margin: 0; } .ds-aside { text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-text { color: #0a0a0a; margin: 0; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Carousel item linking to /work/<id>: 782:407 image well, 24px radius, title below; the screenshot zooms to 1.04 inside the well on hover.
components.css: .ds-work { display: block; width: 390px; text-decoration: none; color: #0a0a0a; font: 500 15px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-work-media { aspect-ratio: 782 / 407; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 24px; background: #e9e9e9; } .ds-work-title { display: inline-block; margin-top: 12px; }

components.name: Round Button
components.description: Carousel prev/next: 44px hit area drawing a 32px sheet circle with a strong hairline; hairline turns ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-round { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: none; background: none; color: #0a0a0a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-round::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; z-index: -1; border: 1px solid #d4d4d4; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-round:hover::before { border-color: #0a0a0a; }

components.name: Icon Dock
components.description: Solid dark capsule fixed bottom-center: logo mark, divider, then Work / Experience / Contact icons; 48x44px targets with label tooltips on hover/focus. No blur, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-dock { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #18181b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #fafafa; } .ds-dock-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; color: rgba(250,250,250,0.55); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-dock-item:hover, .ds-dock-item.is-active { color: #fafafa; } .ds-dock-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fafafa; outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-dock-logo { color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Syne', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-dock-divider { width: 1px; height: 24px; margin: 0 6px; background: rgba(250,250,250,0.2); }

components.name: Section Ruler
components.description: Desktop-only ruler at the right edge: hairline minor ticks, a longer tick per page section, an ink marker at scroll progress; section labels fade in on hover and jump on click. Mouse-only shortcut; the dock is the accessible nav.
components.html: IntroWorkGitHub
components.css: .ds-ruler { position: relative; width: 28px; height: 200px; margin-left: 80px; font: 500 12px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-ruler::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 0 auto; width: 6px; border-right: 1px solid #d4d4d4; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #d4d4d4 0 1px, transparent 1px 10px); } .ds-tick { position: absolute; right: 0; width: 14px; height: 1px; background: #6e6e6e; } .ds-tick.on { background: #0a0a0a; width: 18px; } .ds-lbl { position: absolute; right: 30px; top: -9px; color: #6e6e6e; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tick.on .ds-lbl { color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-marker { position: absolute; right: 0; width: 24px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: #0a0a0a; }

narrative.overview: One narrow column of text on soft grey paper, read top to bottom like a well-set resume. Everything is 15px Inter; hierarchy comes from weight (600 headings, 500 body) and ink tone (ink, graphite, faint), never from size. Images are the only large things on the page, and they live in a single sideways carousel. A dark icon dock floats at the bottom as the one heavy object.
keyCharacteristics: Light only. One paper tone (#f6f6f6), three ink tones, no dark mode.
One typeface, one size: Inter 15px, tight tracking (-0.03em).
A 576px reading column; the carousel and GitHub calendar widen to 782px.
Flat: no blur, no glass, no shadows. Depth is tone plus a 1px hairline.
A dark dock pinned to the bottom; nothing pinned to the top.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text is ink, graphite or faint. Nothing else, no accent color.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: Everything is 15px. Emphasis is weight or ink, never size. Only the dock tip (12px) differs.

rules.name: The 44px Rule
rules.body: Every control has a 44px target: dock items 48x44, round buttons draw 32px inside 44px, the Copy button grows its hit area with padding plus negative margin.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter, translucency, glows or shadows. A surface is a fill plus at most a 1px hairline.

dos: Do keep content in src/lib/content.ts and pass it down as props, so the page stays fully static.
Do stay at 15px Inter and say hierarchy with weight and ink tone.
Do put new list-like content in an info table, not in cards.
Do give every control a 44px target, a visible focus ring and an accessible name.
donts: Don't add dark mode, a theme toggle, or any accent color.
Don't use backdrop-filter, glass, translucency, glows or shadows.
Don't add headline sizes, numbered section kickers or uppercase labels.
Don't lift or scale things on hover; change ink or hairline instead. Only a carousel screenshot zooms, inside its clipped well.
Don't let fixed chrome cover content; pad for the dock.
